# W3-5 fixture: a job NO REAL AGENT CAN CLAIM.
#
# W3-5 needs log lines that arrive at the controller AFTER the run's logs have
# been sealed by the archiver. Sidecars — the one flush point that is post-
# FinishRun by construction — are unavailable on this rig (test/edgecase/README.md
# "Sidecars are NOT available on this rig"), and every remaining agent-side flush
# point (post-hook output at orchestrator.go:706, finally at :727) runs BEFORE
# FinishRun at :787-788. So the late sender is a curl-driven "synthetic agent"
# that enrolls, claims, pushes logs, finishes the run, waits for the REAL
# archiver to seal it, and only then pushes more — every step a documented
# production HTTP route, with the seal produced by the real 30 s archiver tick
# rather than by hand.
#
# The selector is the whole point. `kind:w35probe` matches neither agent1 nor
# agent2 (both `kind:linux`), so a run of this job sits Queued until the
# synthetic identity claims it, and the two real agents are never involved in
# the measurement. The steps below never execute — the run is terminalised
# through POST /api/v1/agents/{id}/runs/{runId}/finish — so their content is
# deliberately trivial; they exist only because a Job needs at least one step.
apiVersion: unified-cd/v1
kind: Job
metadata:
  name: edge-w35-probe
spec:
  native: true
  agentSelector:
    - kind:w35probe
  steps:
    - name: never_runs
      run: echo "w35-probe placeholder — this step is never executed"
